meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查发布前的代码改动,提前发现遗留问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你发布npm包前想要多智能体全面审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 要求发布前审查时,Claude 先运行 /get-unpublished-changes 找出上次发布以来的全部改动,再启动最多10个后台代理分别做深度分析,然后调用 /review-work 做整体审查,最后由 oracle 代理给出发布就绪结论、版本号建议和风险。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求做发布前审查时触发,例如说“pre-publish review”“release review”等;普通的发布请求不会触发,会直接发布。

say.text: 请帮我做一次 pre-publish review,看看当前改动能否发布。
say.note: Claude 会启动多层代理审查并给出结论。

say.text: 发布前先跑 release review,检查有没有破坏性变更。
say.note: 会先检测未发布改动,再逐项深度分析。

say.text: 运行 pre-publish check,告诉我建议的版本号。
say.note: 审查后返回版本号建议和发布风险。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude detects all changes since the last npm release via /get-unpublished-changes, spawns up to 10 agents for per-change analysis, runs /review-work for holistic QA, and uses one oracle to give the final release verdict, version bump, and risk.
howto.when_en: Only when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review, e.g. with phrases like 'pre-publish review' or 'release review'. A plain publish/release request must not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Please run a pre-publish review to see if the current changes are ready.
say_en.note: Claude starts the multi-agent release gate.

say_en.text: Run a release review and check for breaking changes.
say_en.note: It detects unpublished changes and analyzes them first.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish check and recommend a version bump.
say_en.note: Returns a version suggestion and risk assessment.
